overall: Tomorrow (Thursday, July 3) in Los Angeles will feature a classic early-July marine layer pattern: patchy morning fog clearing by late morning, giving way to partly sunny skies in the afternoon. Southwest winds at 5–15 mph will keep conditions mild, with temperatures expected to reach the upper 60s to low 70s — a modest warming from today's observed high of 64.4°F. No severe weather or tropical concerns apply to the LA basin; the active alerts (Lake Wind Advisory near San Luis Reservoir, Air Quality Alert for Imperial County) are geographically distant from the city.
